title: A layer stripping method for numerical solution of the GPR problem in a layered medium
summary: A numerical method for processing the data of ground penetrating radars for a piece-wise continuous layered medium is proposed. The method combines the layer stripping technique with numerical continuation of data into the complex frequency's domain. The accuracy of the method is analyzed. Error estimates are obtained and numerical testing is performed.
